description: Defines classes and structures for generating and validating Non-Zero-Power CSI Reference Signals (NZP-CSI-RS) in a 5G NR context, including configuration parameters and interface methods.

classes.name: nzp_csi_rs_generator
classes.description: Interface for generating NZP-CSI-RS signals according to 3GPP TS38.211.

classes.name: nzp_csi_rs_configuration_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating NZP-CSI-RS generator configuration parameters.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Generates and maps the NZP-CSI-RS signal onto the resource grid.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the configuration parameters for NZP-CSI-RS generation.
